statement: A proper semistable degeneration of complex two-tori with trivial central dualizing line and rank(T-1)=2 has toric rational normalization pairs and dual complex a two-torus even without a Kahler total-space hypothesis.
depends_on: Friedman charge theorem; Dloussky reduced anticanonical classification; Oda hyperbolic link; Grauert base change; actual torus cohomology ring
notes: Root and boundary_d independently passed the revised full proof.
